# Packet examples

<!-- GENERATED by packages/protocol/scripts/generate.ts from packages/protocol/src/vectors.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

These worked examples are the single source for the cross-language agreement test:
the firmware host tests (`firmware/test`) and the TypeScript tests (`packages/protocol`,
`packages/engine`) assert **byte for byte** that they produce and read exactly these packets.
The hex was calculated by hand, independently of the packer.

## Protocol

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Advertised name | `FORCE-` + last four hex characters of the BLE MAC, upper case |
| Service | `3b94f647-2d69-4b87-9cfa-cbd59e4980b1` |
| Telemetry (NOTIFY) | `e16ad3d7-71eb-4ae8-ae94-701c916112ed` |
| Device Info (READ) | `529e09a0-9596-4c47-a9f5-f02da6b2ba91` |
| Packet | 15 bytes, little-endian, one sample per notification |

| Offset | Size | Field | Type | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 2 | seq | uint16 | +1 per sample, wraps at 65536 |
| 2 | 4 | device time | uint32 | ms since boot |
| 6 | 2 | voltage | uint16 | mV |
| 8 | 2 | current | int16 | mA (signed) |
| 10 | 4 | power | uint32 | mW, 0 if current is negative; round half up of mV x mA / 1000 |
| 14 | 1 | flags | uint8 | bit0 sensor fault, bit1 current at limit |

## Telemetry packets

### typical

5.000 V, 250 mA: 1.25 W. Check little-endian layout.

```
01 00 E8 03 00 00 88 13 FA 00 E2 04 00 00 00
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | 01 00 | 1 |
| device time | 2-5 | E8 03 00 00 | 1000 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | 88 13 | 5000 mV |
| current | 8-9 | FA 00 | 250 mA |
| power | 10-13 | E2 04 00 00 | 1250 mW |
| flags | 14 | 00 | 0b00000000 |

### negative_current

Current -12 mA is int16 0xFFF4; power is forced to 0.

```
02 00 1A 04 00 00 74 13 F4 FF 00 00 00 00 00
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | 02 00 | 2 |
| device time | 2-5 | 1A 04 00 00 | 1050 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | 74 13 | 4980 mV |
| current | 8-9 | F4 FF | -12 mA |
| power | 10-13 | 00 00 00 00 | 0 mW |
| flags | 14 | 00 | 0b00000000 |

### seq_max_and_limit_flag

seq 65535 (about to wrap), 12 V at 3200 mA = 38.4 W, current-at-limit flag.

```
FF FF 4E 61 BC 00 E0 2E 80 0C 00 96 00 00 02
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | FF FF | 65535 |
| device time | 2-5 | 4E 61 BC 00 | 12345678 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | E0 2E | 12000 mV |
| current | 8-9 | 80 0C | 3200 mA |
| power | 10-13 | 00 96 00 00 | 38400 mW |
| flags | 14 | 02 | 0b00000010 |

### seq_wrapped_time_max_sensor_fault

seq wrapped to 0, device time at 2^32-1 ms, sensor fault flag, zero readings.

```
00 00 FF FF FF FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | 00 00 | 0 |
| device time | 2-5 | FF FF FF FF | 4294967295 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | 00 00 | 0 mV |
| current | 8-9 | 00 00 | 0 mA |
| power | 10-13 | 00 00 00 00 | 0 mW |
| flags | 14 | 01 | 0b00000001 |

### power_rounds_half_up

500 mV x 1 mA = 500 uW = 0.5 mW rounds up to 1 mW.

```
03 00 D0 07 00 00 F4 01 01 00 01 00 00 00 00
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | 03 00 | 3 |
| device time | 2-5 | D0 07 00 00 | 2000 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | F4 01 | 500 mV |
| current | 8-9 | 01 00 | 1 mA |
| power | 10-13 | 01 00 00 00 | 1 mW |
| flags | 14 | 00 | 0b00000000 |

### power_rounds_down

499 mV x 1 mA = 499 uW = 0.499 mW rounds down to 0 mW.

```
04 00 02 08 00 00 F3 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00
```

| Field | Bytes | Hex (as sent) | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| seq | 0-1 | 04 00 | 4 |
| device time | 2-5 | 02 08 00 00 | 2050 ms |
| voltage | 6-7 | F3 01 | 499 mV |
| current | 8-9 | 01 00 | 1 mA |
| power | 10-13 | 00 00 00 00 | 0 mW |
| flags | 14 | 00 | 0b00000000 |

## Device Info (UTF-8 JSON, fixed key order, no whitespace)

- `{"proto":1,"id":"FORCE-A1B2","fw":"1.0.0","rateHz":20,"limitMa":3200}`
- `{"proto":1,"id":"FORCE-00FF","fw":"1.2.3","rateHz":50,"limitMa":3200}`

## Name from MAC

| BLE MAC | Advertised name |
| --- | --- |
| `24:6F:28:AA:A1:B2` | `FORCE-A1B2` |
| `a4:cf:12:00:0f:ff` | `FORCE-0FFF` |
| `00:00:00:00:00:0a` | `FORCE-000A` |
